source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Topic 5.3.1.2 (PDF 133, printed 130).

blocks.text: Observation (ghaur se dekhna) mein logon ya cheezon ko un ke natural environment (asal, aam jagah) mein dekh kar ya un par nazar rakh kar data jama kiya jata hai. Yeh tareeqa tab useful hai jab researchers behavior (log kya karte hain) ya kisi hone wali cheez (phenomenon) ka data baghair interference (dakhal, rok tok) ke jama karna chahte hon.

Misal: Ek restaurant jaanna chahta hai ke lunch ke waqt customers kaunsi tables sab se zyada chunte hain. Ek staff member ek hafte tak dekhta hai ke log kahan baithte hain. Is observation ki bunyad par restaurant tables ki setting badalta hai ta ke customers ko aaram ho aur aana jana aasan ho; is se customers khush rehte hain aur service tez aur behtar hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Customers se poochne ki bajaye observation behtar data kyun de sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Observation yeh likhta hai ke log asal mein kya karte hain, na ke woh kya kehte hain, aur un ke kaam mein dakhal nahi deta.

items: Observation: baghair dakhal ke dekhna; misal: ek hafte tak lunch par kaunsi tables chuni gayin.
